instruction: Export the image file OIP.jpg (found in /home/user) to PDF format, saving the output as 'receipt.pdf' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task converts single image to PDF. Evaluator verifies: (1) PDF has exactly 1 page as expected for single image conversion (0.5), (2) page has valid dimensions (width > 0, height > 0) confirming proper image embedding (0.5). Verified against source image which is a single receipt.

scoring_breakdown.1.0: Page has valid dimensions (width > 0 and height > 0)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches the PDF file from the specified Desktop path (/home/user/Desktop/receipt.pdf)
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' (uses expected.get('page_count') directly, not expected.get('rules'))
Page count check (== 1) is semantically correct for single image to PDF conversion
Dimension validation (width > 0, height > 0) confirms proper image embedding in PDF
Filename verification is implicit: getter will fail if file not named 'receipt.pdf', returning None and score 0.0
Partial credit scoring is appropriate (0.5 for page count, 0.5 for valid dimensions)
Edge cases well handled: None file, missing file, corrupted PDF all return 0.0
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Could add explicit logging to indicate which check failed (page count vs dimensions) for debugging purposes, but this is not critical for correctness
